squirrel.services.storage.database.IDatabaseService

class squirrel.services.storage.database.IDatabaseService.IDatabaseService[source]

Bases: ABC

Abstract base class for database service implementations.

Subclasses must implement all abstract methods for their specific database backend. Optional lifecycle methods (connect / disconnect) have no-op defaults so lightweight implementations can skip them.

The class also supports the context-manager protocol so callers can write:

with MyDatabaseService() as db:
    db.query("SELECT 1")
connect()[source]

Establish a connection to the database.

Subclasses should override this to open a real connection.

Returns:

Connection object, or None for no-op defaults.

Return type:

Any

disconnect()[source]

Close the database connection.

Subclasses should override this to cleanly release resources.

Returns:

None

Return type:

None

Execute a read query and return all matching rows.

Parameters:

query (str) – Raw SQL string to execute.

Returns:

Mapping like {"success": True, "rows": [...], "columns": [...], "rowcount": N} on success, or None on failure.

Return type:

Optional[dict]

Parameters:

Returns:

True on success, False on failure.

bool

abstract update(query, data)[source]

Update rows identified by query with the values in data.

Parameters:

  • query (str) – WHERE clause (with or without the WHERE keyword) used to narrow which rows are updated, or a full SQL string when data contains "sql".

  • data (dict) – Either {"sql": "<raw SQL>", "params": {...}} for a prepared statement, or {"table": "<name>", "values": {...}, "where": "…"} for structured updates.

Returns:

True on success, False on failure.

Return type:

bool

abstract delete(query)[source]

query (str) – Full DELETE FROM … WHERE … SQL statement.

Returns:

True on success, False on failure.

Return type:

bool

abstract retrieve(table, filters=None)[source]

Fetch rows from table, optionally filtered by filters.

Parameters:

  • table (str) – Name of the table to query.

  • filters (Optional[dict]) – Column/value pairs applied as col = value AND conditions. Pass None or {} to return all rows.

Returns:

Same shape as query() on success, or None on failure.

Return type:

Optional[dict]

abstract execute_many(statement, params_seq)[source]

Execute statement once for each parameter mapping in params_seq.

Useful for bulk inserts or batch updates within a single transaction.

Parameters:

  • statement (str) – Parameterised SQL string (%(col)s placeholders).

  • params_seq (list[dict]) – List of parameter dictionaries, one per execution.

Returns:

True if all executions succeeded, False otherwise.

Return type:

bool
